_meta.description: Receives the MeetSum 'meeting.completed' webhook (payload v2), verifies x-meetsum-signature-v2 and posts a summary to a Slack channel. Private meetings arrive with ids only and are skipped by the filter.
setup: 2. Configure your Slack API credential and set the target #channel
3. Copy the production webhook URL from the Webhook node

4. In MeetSum, Settings → Integrations → Webhooks (or POST /api/webhooks/subscriptions { url: '<webhook-url>', events: ['meeting.completed'], payloadVersion: 2 }): create a v2 subscription and copy the secret (shown once)

5. Set the n8n environment variable MEETSUM_WEBHOOK_SECRET to the subscription secret shown once by MeetSum (allow env access in Code nodes, or paste the secret into the 'Verify MeetSum signature' node).
6. Activate the workflow, then use 'Test webhook' in MeetSum to send a signed example
